text:
You need a new website and graphic design for a property management company in Italy, with well-structured pages for services, blog, projects, and especially strong About Us and Our Team pages, all presented with a polished visual style and high-quality imagery.

Hi, I’m Tobias Reyne, and I’d be glad to help you build a professional, modern website that presents your company clearly and gives visitors a strong first impression. With 7 years of experience in web development and design-focused frontend work, I can support both the structure and the visual quality of the site so it feels clean, trustworthy, and easy to explore.

For a project like this, I would focus on creating a thoughtful page layout that highlights your services, showcases your projects, and makes your company story stand out through the About Us and Our Team sections. I’d also make sure the blog is easy to manage and the overall design feels consistent across the site, with attention to typography, spacing, and image presentation. Since you mentioned the importance of nice pictures and a nice presentation, I would keep the design refined and professional, with visuals that support your brand rather than overwhelm it.

My background includes JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, full stack development, HTML, and CSS, so I can handle both the front-end experience and the technical implementation needed for a smooth website. That means I can build a site that looks great and is also practical to maintain and expand.

If you’d like, I can help turn your content into a clear, elegant website that reflects the quality of your property management company and makes it easy for clients to understand who you are and what you offer. I’d be happy to discuss your preferred style, page structure, and any visual references you already have.
